title: ACQUISITION BY AFRICAN BANKING CORPORATION (TANZANIA) LIMITED OF CONSUMER PRIVATE BANKING BUSINESS OF STANDARD CHARTERED BANK TANZANIA.
title_sw: ACQUISITION BY AFRICAN BANKING CORPORATION (TANZANIA) LIMITED OF CONSUMER PRIVATE BANKING BUSINESS OF STANDARD CHARTERED BANK TANZANIA.
text:
DATE OF THE DECISION: 31st October 2024
African Banking Corporation (Tanzania) Limited notified the Fair Competition Commission of their intention to acquire consumer private banking business of Standard Chartered Bank Tanzania Limited for the going concern.
Relevant market was defined as provision of retail banking activities to individuals and SMEs in Dar es Salaam, Mwanza and Arusha.
Based on the analysis, post-merger scenarios market shares of ABC Tanzania will not exceed 35 percent and hence both perspectives of Section 5 (6) (a) and (b) of FCA will not be confirmed and thus having no possibility of either creating or strengthening a position of dominance in the relevant market. The merger was approved.
